task: A hypervisor's uplink to SW1 carries guest frames tagged for VLANs 10 and 20. Set the Layer 2 mode of this switch port. The native VLAN and allowed list are configured separately.

teaching.hint: Choose from the frames on this uplink: more than one tagged VLAN.
teaching.takeaway: A trunk carries both tagged guest VLANs on one link. It does not route between them, and a working host-management NIC proves nothing about this uplink.
